dict.string: Smolcorp turns what you say into text, on this Mac only, while you hold the mic on your phone, for agents without a voice mode of their own. Nothing is recorded or sent anywhere.
Smolcorp turns what you say into text on this Mac, for agents without a voice mode of their own.
Smolcorp brings your coding agents' tabs forward in Terminal and types commands into them, and with the office's jukebox on, asks Spotify and Music whether they're playing.
